intent: Rebuild the UI/UX around analysis execution and understanding.
Improve the analysis process so incidents and analytical problems do not create circular work.
Make the modular analytical engine the core of the product.
Accept a partially manual assisted workflow until materially stronger local hardware is available.

product_objective: A high-quality equity-research operating system that automates deterministic work, makes analytical state visible, prevents unproductive loops, and routes judgment-heavy modules through assisted human-in-the-loop analysis.

pillars.objective: Turn OroTitan from a publication/snapshot interface into an analysis cockpit.
Make every retry, repair, deeper pass or escalation evidence-driven and bounded.
target_capabilities: human escalation when analytical judgment is required

pillars.objective: Define the complete analytical engine as explicit modules with dependencies, evidence requirements, output contracts, depth rules and human authority.

ui_ux_target.current_problem: The current UI is primarily a canonical publication/snapshot cockpit. It does not expose the live analytical workflow, module state, blockers, evidence quality or next action clearly enough.

analysis_workspace_layout.left_rail: Stages and analytical modules with status, blockers and completion.
analysis_workspace_layout.main_panel: Current module analysis, structured findings, assumptions and human actions.
analysis_workspace_layout.right_rail: Evidence, source/conflict references, validation state, issues and controls.
analysis_workspace_layout.header: Company, run, cutoff, current stage, overall readiness and one explicit next action.

design_principles: Expose decisions and blockers before raw technical detail.
One obvious next action per active run.
No hidden analytical state in chat history.
Technical JSON remains inspectable but not the primary UX.
Evidence and counterevidence are first-class UI objects.
Historical and current canonical state remain visually separated.

anti_loop_process.principle: A module may continue only when the next pass has a stated information gain or a deterministic repair target.
stop_rules: Do not rerun when evidence set and failure fingerprint are unchanged and no deterministic repair is available.
Do not deepen analysis merely because a module is difficult; deepen only on existing adaptive-depth triggers.
Do not use a model retry to repair an evidence-identity or methodology defect.
Escalate immediately when the recovery engine classifies semantic/historical authority risk as human-required.
After repeated no-progress state, close the loop with a terminal blocker or human decision instead of creating more forensic substeps.

default_retry_policy.transient_technical: bounded automatic retry only when existing recovery-engine proofs pass
default_retry_policy.deterministic_contract_defect: one targeted deterministic repair path when uniquely provable

analysis_engine.routing_principle: Do not execute every possible module at maximum depth. Run CORE modules and activate conditional overlays/depth only when evidence, archetype, uncertainty or materiality triggers justify them.

assisted_inference_bridge.objective: Allow judgment-heavy modules to use a high-capability interactive model with structured import/validation while current local hardware is insufficient.
assisted_inference_bridge.future_replaceability: INTERACTIVE_LLM can later be replaced by a LOCAL_INFERENCE_ADAPTER without changing module contracts or persistence.
